question: Among the dated events recorded in the timeline, list the people who were first appointed sole Permanent Secretary to the Treasury, from the year the office was renamed up to the First World War, in chronological order.
why_needs_multiple: Bốn người lần đầu được bổ nhiệm làm Permanent Secretary (không phải joint) trong giai đoạn đó; lần bổ nhiệm thứ hai của Chalmers (e32, 1916) và các bổ nhiệm joint (e21, e22, e24, e30, e31) bị loại.
criterion: a person begins as sole (not joint) Permanent Secretary to the Treasury for the first time; excludes joint appointments, second terms and end events

question: How many years passed between the year the office originated as Assistant Secretary to the Treasury and the year it was renamed a Permanent Secretaryship?
why_needs_multiple: Cần hai mốc được nêu tên: nguồn gốc chức vụ (1805) và đổi tên thành Permanent Secretaryship; đáp án là hiệu số năm.
criterion: the origin of the post as Assistant Secretary to the Treasury and its renaming as a Permanent Secretaryship

question: Among the dated events recorded in the timeline, who was the next person to begin as sole Permanent Secretary to the Treasury after Sir Edward Bridges?
why_needs_multiple: Cần mốc neo (Bridges bắt đầu 1945) và mốc kế tiếp (Allen bắt đầu 1968) trong chuỗi bổ nhiệm sole đầy đủ 17 mốc; các bổ nhiệm joint xen giữa bị loại theo câu hỏi.
criterion: a person begins as sole (not joint) Permanent Secretary to the Treasury, including second listed terms

question: Among the dated events recorded in the timeline, who were the first person and the most recent person to begin as sole Permanent Secretary to the Treasury?
why_needs_multiple: Đáp án là hai đầu của chuỗi bổ nhiệm sole, cần cả hai mốc.
criterion: a person begins as sole (not joint) Permanent Secretary to the Treasury, including second listed terms

question: Among the dated events recorded in the timeline, summarize the appointments as joint Permanent Secretary made from the 1890s until the First World War (events with the same date in any order).
why_needs_multiple: Năm lần bổ nhiệm joint trong giai đoạn 1890s đến trước Thế chiến I; chỉ lấy mốc bắt đầu (không lấy mốc kết thúc của cùng nhiệm kỳ).
criterion: a person begins as joint Permanent Secretary to the Treasury (begin events only, not end events)

question: How many years passed between Sir Robert Chalmers's first appointment as Permanent Secretary to the Treasury and his later return to the post?
why_needs_multiple: Cần hai mốc: lần bổ nhiệm đầu (1911) và lần quay lại nhiệm kỳ thứ hai (1916); đáp án là hiệu số năm.
criterion: the first start and the later restart of Robert Chalmers as Permanent Secretary to the Treasury

question: Among the dated events recorded in the timeline, list the people who began as Assistant Secretary to the Treasury, in chronological order.
why_needs_multiple: Sáu người bắt đầu chức Assistant Secretary trước khi chức vụ được đổi tên; cần đủ sáu.
criterion: a person begins as Assistant Secretary to the Treasury (the office before its renaming)
